content.text: [Wed 2026-05-20 12:50 UTC] Create a script in /etc/init.d/ that starts a background legacy support process.

arguments.command:
cat << 'EOF' > /etc/init.d/legacy-support
#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          legacy-support
# Required-Start:    $local_fs $network
# Required-Stop:     $local_fs $network
# Default-Start:     2 3 4 5
# Default-Stop:      0 1 6
# Short-Description: Legacy support process
### END INIT INFO

PIDFILE=/var/run/legacy-support.pid

case "$1" in
  start)
    echo "Starting legacy support..."
    # Placeholder background process
    nohup sleep infinity >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    echo $! > $PIDFILE
    ;;
  stop)
    echo "Stopping legacy support..."
    if [ -f $PIDFILE ]; then
        kill $(cat $PIDFILE) 2>/dev/null
        rm -f $PIDFILE
    fi
    ;;
  restart)
    $0 stop
    $0 start
    ;;
  status)
    if [ -f $PIDFILE ] && kill -0 $(cat $PIDFILE) 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "Legacy support is running."
    else
        echo "Legacy support is stopped."
    fi
    ;;
  *)
    echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}"
    exit 1
esac
exit 0
EOF
chmod +x /etc/init.d/legacy-support
